description: Local agents that keep an offline server healthy: they find what is broken, fix it only from a catalogue of approved, reversible repairs, prove each fix with a done test, undo it if the test fails, and escalate everything else to a human with the evidence.

sponsors.zetaris: Evidence store: ari writes every observation as a row to a postgres db registered in Zetaris as ari_evidence, and the investigator reads them back with Lightning SQL; every cause cites row ids.
sponsors.meterless: Nightshift is the fixer's model runtime (meterless/auto, with compute receipts logged per pick); Scout Intent is implemented in Go from the published spec and signs the only contract the verifier accepts.
sponsors.nvidia: The models behind Nightshift are NVIDIA cloud endpoints (build.nvidia.com); each pick's log line names the model that answered.
sponsors.cursor: Used during development as a builder and code reviewer: built the laptop demo (deploy/local/demo.sh) and the README's try it without servers section; code reviews of the engine and the deploy script found two real bugs, both fixed (an empty Nightshift token in deploy/recreate.sh, and ari status reporting a failed undo as undone); scanned the full git history for secrets with gitleaks.
